name: Mostafa Kamal
contribution: Lance Naik Mostafa Kamal, later recognised as Bir Sreshtho, held a defensive position at Daruin during the 1971 war.
context: He remained in action against a larger Pakistani assault, covering the withdrawal of fellow fighters until he was killed.
impact: His stand became one of Bangladesh’s defining examples of battlefield sacrifice and collective protection.
highlight: He chose to hold the line so others could survive.
